cards.card_text: Its writer asks God to vindicate him and plead his case against an ungodly nation.
cards.verse_text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
cards.snippet: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.

cards.card_text: Next, Solomon talks about the mouth: with his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor.
cards.verse_text: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
cards.snippet: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.

cards.card_text: The ungodly man destroys his neighbor with his mouth.
cards.verse_text: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.
cards.snippet: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor, but through knowledge the righteous are rescued.

cards.card_text: And Solomon closes the chapter with one last line: "If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!" That's a LOT to weigh, friend.
cards.verse_text: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!
cards.snippet: If the righteous receive their due on earth, how much more the ungodly and the sinner!

cards.card_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid, and trembling grips the ungodly.
cards.verse_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire?
cards.snippet: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire?

cards.card_text: Trembling, the ungodly in Zion ask a question.
cards.verse_text: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire?
cards.snippet: The sinners in Zion are afraid; trembling grips the ungodly: “Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire?

cards.card_text: The LORD says both prophet and ___ are ungodly, and He has found their wickedness even in His ___.
cards.verse_text: “For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.
cards.snippet: “For both prophet and priest are ungodly; even in My house I have found their wickedness,” declares the LORD.

cards.card_text: The ungodly The deserving The hardworking
cards.verse_text: However, to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is credited as righteousness.
cards.snippet: …one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is credited as righteousness.

cards.verse_text: For at just the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
cards.snippet: …the right time, while we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

cards.card_text: Paul says the law is for the lawless and rebellious, and he keeps going down a long list: the ungodly and sinful, murderers, the sexually immoral, slave traders, liars and more.
cards.verse_text: We realize that law is not enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or mother, for murderers, for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
cards.snippet: …enacted for the righteous, but for the lawless and rebellious, for the ungodly and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for killers of father or…

cards.card_text: Then Peter quotes Proverbs 11:31, and friend, I read it once, put the dough down, and read it AGAIN with both eyebrows up: "If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?"
cards.verse_text: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
cards.snippet: …hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”

cards.card_text: God did not spare it when He brought the flood on its ungodly people.
cards.verse_text: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
cards.snippet: …not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;

cards.card_text: As an example of what is coming on the ungodly As a warning to the king of Egypt To make room for the tribes of Israel
cards.verse_text: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
cards.snippet: …them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;

cards.card_text: And they're being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
cards.verse_text: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
cards.snippet: …for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

cards.card_text: Jude says these ungodly men were designated long ago for condemnation.
cards.verse_text: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation.
cards.snippet: For certain men have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones who were designated long ago for condemnation.

cards.card_text: Enoch says the Lord will convict the ungodly of their wicked acts, but not of the harsh words they spoke against Him.
cards.verse_text: to execute judgment on everyone, and to convict all the ungodly of every ungodly act of wickedness and every harsh word spoken against Him by ungodly sinners.”
